Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.glider

Interface GliderService

public interface GliderService
Zentrix's built-in gliders: the catalog players choose from, the glides in progress and the previews shown in the cosmetics menu.

Players glide into the map from the dragon bus or a sky drop. While gliding they wear their glider - the one they chose and still own, or the server's default - on their back and drift forward under Slow Falling until they land. Which gliders a player owns is managed by CosmeticsService.

The glider catalog is not part of the Free edition: there isCatalogAvailable() is false, the catalog is empty, and deploy(org.bukkit.entity.Player) and preview(org.bukkit.entity.Player, java.lang.String) fail, while isGliding(org.bukkit.entity.Player) and stop(org.bukkit.entity.Player) still cover the glides Zentrix starts itself. Every method that changes something must be called on the main thread.

Since:
1.8.0
